sources.facts: Glitch-free supply sequencing is specified. Isolation with one supply below 100 mV or disconnected requires complementary supply within recommended conditions. OE should remain low/floating through transitions.
sources.inference: Upstream invalid OE generation, remote receiver injection and an indefinite partial-power state still require board-level analysis; do not claim the translator lacks sequencing support.

sources.facts: Differential input voltage relative to supply requires review during supply loss.
sources.inference: A bounded series-input current does not itself establish valid outputs or isolation.

allocated_not_sourced: Reverse-block path drop, ESR, effective capacitance, total load and reverse leakage
1 ms healthy qualification, 1 us clear hold, 100 ns release/arm guards
